name: prompt-chain-workspace
description: Visual Node-Based LLM Prompt Pipeline Builder

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "client,server" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "client,server" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm start --prefix server"
